jobs_results.title: Desarrollador android kotlin
jobs_results.description:
Tu nueva empresa

Desde Hays Consultora de Selección nos encontramos inmersos en un proyecto para Mercadona, empresa familiar líder del sector retail que actualmente cuenta con una plantilla de 96.000 personas y más de 1.600 supermercados entre España y Portugal. Mercadona se encuentra trabajando en la digitalización interna de la empresa, proporcionando soluciones de software a los diferentes departamentos del negocio a través de sus más de 300 aplicaciones internas en un contexto de continuas propuestas de innovación.

Tu nuevo puesto

Buscamos incorporar un Android Developer para el desarrollo de aplicaciones nativas con Kotlin que quiera progresar en su carrera dentro de entornos de trabajo multidisciplinares para su delegación de Valencia.

Qué necesitarás para encajar con el puesto

- Estudios (opciones):

- Grado en Informática.
- Grado en Telecomunicaciones.
- Ciclo Grado Superior en Informática.

- Idiomas: inglés B1.

- Stack tecnológico:

- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en... Kotlin
- Uso de APIs REST
- Tests unitarios
- Inyección de dependencias (Dagger o Hilt)
- BBDD locales (Room o similar)
- Livedata, corutinas, databinding y MVVM

Qué obtendrás a cambio

- Empleo estable y de calidad, con contrato indefinido directamente con cliente final
- Herramientas tecnológicas de última generación
- Salario competitivo
- Desarrollo de plan de carrera con formación continua
- Trabajar con metodologías Agile junto a un equipo de expertos multidisciplinares
- Asistencia a eventos
- Buen ambiente de trabajo, horario flexible y seguridad laboral

Tu siguiente paso

jobs_results.title: Android Mobile Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native company that helps organizations reinvent themselves and unleash their potential. Our innovative approach combines design, engineering, and scale to create cutting-edge solutions for our clients.

Right now, we are looking for an Android Developer to join our team!

You will get the chance to:
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.
• Be part of an agile pod. Driven by a culture of self-regulated teamwork, each team -or POD- works directly with our customers with a full maturity path that evolves as they increase speed, quality and... autonomy.

What will help you succeed:
• Advanced or intermediate English skills.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in Android Development.
• Live in Spain
• Enjoy solving problems.
• Expert understanding of the Android System APIs, Android app lifecycle.
• Solid knowledge of the Kotlin Language.
• Knowledge of open-source and commercial libraries commonly used in the Android ecosystem, including Android architecture components, jetpack libraries, okhttp, retrofit, dagger.
• Knowledge of multi-threaded, asynchronous code.
• Experience with animation, and implementing user interface designs.
• Knowledge of architectural patterns such as MVVM and MVP.
• Skilled at writing Unit tests and Automation tests with Espresso.
• Good understanding of Web services and SOA related standards like REST/JSON.
• BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience/skills.

If you want to know more about our benefits and perks click here.

Job Segment: User Experience, Developer, Open Source, Computer Science, Animation, Technology, Creative

jobs_results.description:
Somos más de 2.400 talentos 😵 pero, ¡nos faltas tú!

En knowmad mood continuamos apostando por la tecnología 💻, por la innovación pero sobre todo por LAS PERSONAS🧔, con muchos retos que descubrir y sueños por cumplir. ¿Serás tú el nuevo miembro del equipo que estamos buscando🕵️?

Se abre una apasionante oportunidad en nuestra Comunidad Mobile; precisamos incorporar a un Android Developer con al menos 4 años de experiencia para asumir un nuevo reto 🏂. Formarás parte de nuestro equipo, donde trabajarás con proyectos de todo tipo 🙌🏼. ¡Y puedes trabajar 100% en remoto si tu quieres!

Y te preguntarás, 🤔 ¿Qué estamos buscando?
• Una persona con experiencia en este role y funciones
• Experiencia de unos 5 años en desarrollo de aplicaciones mobile con Android (Kotlin)
• Valorable experiencia previa en Jetpack Compose 😻 nos enamora
• Experiencia trabajando y utilizando Kotlin, Java, Arquitectura MVVM, Retrofit... 🤟

¿Qué más se puede pedir?

Pues además puedes contar con beneficios... como:

· Te podrás beneficiar de un completo programa de beneficios y descuentos 💰 (ocio, tecnología, bienestar y salud 💆🏻...) ¿Quieres ejemplos? Tienes infinitas posibilidades desde contratar Gympass o Fisio-Empresas 🏋🏼 pasando por ofertas en móviles y portátiles, hasta descuentos para irte de viaje, reservar un vuelo o pillar un alquiler de coche ¡Tú elijes!

· Acceso y formación de todo tipo 🤓 en conocimiento técnico, habilidades o idiomas.

· Participación en eventos tecnológicos 💻. Nosotros somos patrocinadores de eventos como el Codemotion, t3chfest y sobre todo estamos orgullosos de ser los organizadores de eventos técnicos como el blockchain spain y DevOps Spain.

· Nos acordamos de ti en los momentos importantes de tu vida 🎉 (aniversario de trabajo, cumpleaños 🍰 y nacimiento 👼🏽). ¡Tienes sorpresa asegurada!

·Vamos más allá del trabajo, por eso nos gusta organizar los Family days, para que te diviertas con tu familia en knowmad mood💃🏼.

· Tienes acceso a nuestros meetups, techdays y a nuestro blog tecnológico 😎 ¿Todavía no conoces https://enmilocalfunciona.io/?

· Actividades de Teambuilding: Nos gusta divertirnos y estar en contacto con nuestros 🚣🏿

· 📴22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición + 24 y 31 de diciembre libres)

· MASVIDA, conciliación en tu vida personal y laboral. Un/a asistente 24h al día 365 días para tí y tu familia 🤲

¿Te atreves? ¡Únete a la revolución!🤙

jobs_results.title: Senior android developer
jobs_results.description:
• Please only apply for this role if you are currently in a Senior Android Developer Role*

## About the Role

Exciting opportunity to join a new and ambitious gaming technology platform. Be part of a team to bring new and innovative products to market and have a significant input to the direction and success of the business. The team are looking at innovative ways to optimise the user experience through applying design, data analytics and AI driven content optimisation to improve the player experience. You will be part of the technical leadership team driving this initiative forward.

Specifically you will be integral in creating high quality, native, first class Android applications for the iGaming industry from the ground up. Initially you will be working on a greenfield project and will have to work closely with the mobile lead, helping them with critical architectural decisions that will define the project and team going forward.

This is a role for the person that gets excited... about new technologies, gets nerdy architectural discussions and gets a kick out of seeing new things come to life.

## Responsibilities

Working in an agile, cross functional team working to first class native Android applications.
Owning the Android code base and ensuring it adheres to high quality metrics. Such a unit test coverage, readability and conformity.

Working with the mobile lead on architectural decisions within the application technology stack.

Working with the mobile lead to develop processes that enable teams to deliver high quality applications with maximum automation.

Work with the product team to iteratively improve the end user’s experience.
Take ownership of production services and resolve support issues in a timely manner
Proactively identify areas of improvement in current processes and practices

## Skills

- 5+ years of experience in developing mobile applications (native or hybrid), with excellent knowledge of mobile app dev frameworks: Knowledgeable in all aspects of the mobile app lifecycle (concept, design, develop, debug/test, release, support, security, performance)

- Experience with mobile delivery and integration of application systems with the Google Play store.

- Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills and strong teamwork relationships

## Requirements

- Demonstrable experience developing native mobile development using Kotlin or Flutter

- Strong understanding of, and experience writing unit testing.

- Experience with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Coroutines desirable.

- Excitement about native-first cross platform technologies such as Kotlin Multiplatform for Mobile or Flutter

- Understanding of hybrid apps & communication between webpages and native code.

- Experience on 3rd Party SDKs integration

-Excellent communication skills

- Exposure to some level of project management e.g. estimation, planning, task tracking

## Location

This role is fully remote and open to anywhere in the EU but will require occasional travel for collaboration once or twice a year to the Markortech offices in Gibraltar, Malta or London.

## Additional Information

Fully remote with occasional in person meetings in Gibraltar, Malta or London for collaboration.

We offer a friendly, collaborative working environment with a high level of autonomy and time for exploring innovative technology ideas in a fast paced start up model.

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: 5,000.00€ - 6,000.00€ per month

COVID-19 considerations:
Fully Remote

We are posting this role on behalf of our client. You will be able to see more details about the hiring company once you start your application.

Company

Our client is one of the market leaders of the user experience testing industry and highest-growing platforms, is currently seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Android Developer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for converting inbound leads into satisfied customers, and prospecting outbound leads.

Company is headquartered in Miami and has a significant operation based in Madrid. While they highly value in-person collaboration, they fully embrace a remote-first approach and are happy to consider applicants regardless of location, subject to time zone compatibility.

Overview:

We are actively seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Senior Android Developer to join our client’s dynamic team. As a crucial member of the development team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge mobile... applications. You will play a pivotal role in shaping company’s app's future, utilizing both MVVM (Model-View-View-Model) and MVP (Model-View-Presenter) architectural patterns.

Responsibilities:

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications.

- Implement and maintain the MVVM and MVP architecture to ensure code scalability and maintainability.

- Utilize Gradle for efficient dependency management, ensuring smooth integration of third-party libraries.

- Work proficiently with various AndroidX libraries, including AppCompat, Core-KTX, and Material Design, to deliver a seamless user experience.

- Harness the power of Kotlin Coroutines for efficient and responsive asynchronous programming.

- Employ Koin for dependency injection, enhancing code modularity and maintainability.

- Prioritize data security by utilizing AndroidX Security Crypto for secure data storage and encryption.

- Implement and integrate essential Firebase services such as Crashlytics, Analytics, Messaging, and Performance Monitoring.

- Leverage RxJava for reactive programming and Retrofit for efficient network communication.

- Enhance network requests with the OkHttp3 logging interceptor, ensuring robust and efficient data retrieval.

- Collaborate with Amazon Web Services (AWS) SDK for seamless S3 and Cognito integration.

- Implement Amplitude for advanced analytics capabilities, gaining valuable insights into user behavior.

- Incorporate OpenTok to enable video communication within the app, enhancing user engagement.

- Work with the Chat-UI framework to facilitate in-app messaging features, promoting user interaction.

- Create captivating animations using Lottie, enhancing the app's visual appeal.

- Implement background tasks efficiently using Android Work Manager.

- Design responsive and user-friendly interfaces with ConstraintLayout.

- Conduct thorough unit and UI testing using JUnit, Espresso, and other testing frameworks.

- Implement navigation using Android Navigation Components, ensuring seamless user journeys.

- Optional: Utilize test helpers like LocaleChanger for comprehensive testing coverage.

Requirements:

- Extensive experience in mobile app development on the Android platform, with a proven track record of leading projects or teams.

- Deep expertise in MVVM and MVP architectural patterns.

- Proficiency in Kotlin, Gradle, and effective dependency management.

- Familiarity with AndroidX libraries and industry best practices.

- Experience with Firebase services, RxJava, Retrofit, and OkHttp3.

- Knowledge of AWS SDK, Amplitude, OpenTok, and Lottie.

- Previous exposure to Android Work Manager and ConstraintLayout is a valuable asset.

- Exceptional problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.

- Strong leadership, teamwork, and communication skills.

- Proficiency in Spanish at an advanced level, both in writing and speaking, is critical for effective collaboration with our team. Moreover, a proficient command of English is essential for seamless integration with various tools and technical documentation, as well as for engaging in communications across the company
